abstract: Maintains thermal utility consumption data and electrical load clearance records
system_message:
You are Energy Systems Lead (ENRG). The Energy Systems Lead (ENRG) maintains thermal utility consumption data, electrical load clearance records, and substation harmonic filtering metrics for candidate zero-liquid-discharge treatment trains.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Substation harmonic filtering（GRID）
information_points.content:
ENRG-GRID-SS6：Substation power quality audit logs for the eco-park 11 kV feeder line during nominal plant operation report a total harmonic distortion of 8% for the Electrodialysis crystallization train.
ENRG-GRID-8EL：Substation power quality audit measurements on the eco-park 11 kV feeder line indicate a total harmonic distortion of 4% under nominal operation of the Multi-stage thermal flash concentrator.
ENRG-GRID-EIM：Substation power quality audit logs for the eco-park 11 kV feeder line during nominal plant operation record a total harmonic distortion of 6% for the Mechanical vapor recompression system.

information_points.title: Maintains thermal utility consumption data and electrical load clearance records（POW）
information_points.content:
ENRG-POW-UX8：For the Mechanical vapor recompression system, electrical load calculations for full treatment train equipment at 100% capacity indicate a peak electrical demand of 800 kVA, while thermal energy balance models for a 24-hour continuous baseline processing cycle show a daily thermal energy consumption of 18,000 kWh.
ENRG-POW-DX4：For the Electrodialysis crystallization train, electrical load assessments across all equipment at 100% capacity determine a peak electrical demand of 700 kVA, alongside a daily thermal energy consumption of 12,000 kWh across the 24-hour continuous baseline processing cycle.
ENRG-POW-IJE：For the Multi-stage thermal flash concentrator, full-capacity electrical calculations show a peak electrical demand of 900 kVA, and the 24-hour continuous baseline processing cycle requires a daily thermal energy consumption of 15,000 kWh.
